content: विजयः .²1 Overcoming, vanquishing, defeating. .²2 Conquest, victory, triumph; दिग्विजयादारभ्य ‘conquest of the world’; प्रभवति न तदा परो विजेतुं भवति जितेन्द्रियता यदात्मरक्षा <ls>Ki. 10. 35</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 44</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 19</ls>; अस्याधिज्ये धनुषि विजयम् <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>. .²3 A chariot of the gods, celestial chariot. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Arjuna; <ls>Mb.</ls> (4. 44. 14) thus explains the name:-- अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं युद्धदुर्मदान् . नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मां विजयं विदुः ... .²4 An epithet of Yama. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the first year of Jupiterʼs cycle. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of an attendant of Viṣṇu. .²7 Motion, march; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular मुहूर्त; युक्ते मुहूर्ते विजये <ls>Rām. 1. 73. 9</ls>. .²9 The third month. .²10 A kind of military array. .²11 A kind of measure. .{@-यम्@} A royal tent.
